source: GOV.UK organisations and their content descriptions

bodies.name: Government Project Delivery
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Project delivery function
bodies.description: Government Project Delivery is the function and profession for project delivery in the UK government. The Government Project Delivery is part of the Civil Service and the National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority .

bodies.name: Civil Service Commission
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: The Civil Service Commission regulates recruitment into the Civil Service, ensuring that appointments are made on merit after fair and open competition. It also hears complaints under the Civil Service Code. CSC is an executive non-departmental public body, sponsored by the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Civil Service Fast Stream
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: The Civil Service Fast Stream team runs the government’s flagship Fast Stream graduate programme. The Civil Service Fast Stream is part of Civil Service Resourcing and the Government People Group .

bodies.name: Government People Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: The Government People Function is the cross-government community of civil servants who support or enable the delivery of human resources (HR) in the Civil Service. GPF works with the Civil Service and the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government People Group
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: Government People Group (GPG) is the strategic and functional centre for the Government People Function and human resources (HR) in the Civil Service. GPG is part of the Cabinet Office and the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Recruitment Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: The Government Recruitment Service (GRS) was launched in September 2017 and is part of the Cabinet Office’s Government People Group. GRS delivers award-winning recruitment services and functions for organisations across the Civil Service, supporting and enabling the recruitment of exceptional civil servants. GRS is part of the Government People Group .

bodies.name: Leadership College for Government
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: The Leadership College for Government equips public and Civil Service leaders with the skills, knowledge, and networks to solve today’s most complex problems. LCG is part of the Cabinet Office and the Government Skills and Curriculum Unit .

bodies.name: UK Shared Business Services Ltd
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the People function
bodies.description: UKSBS is a shared services provider to government, providing HR and payroll, finance, procurement, and IT business services. UKSBS works with the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade .

bodies.name: Government Estates Management
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Property function
bodies.description: We are responsible for providing solutions to specialist estates management issues across government. GEM works with the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Property Agency
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Property function
bodies.description: The Government Property Agency is leading the largest commercial office programme in the UK to transform how the Civil Service works. GPA is an executive agency, sponsored by the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Property Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Property function
bodies.description: The Government Property Function operates across departments, delivery organisations and agencies. It is a network of over 5,000 members with responsibility for a range of property-related activities. GPF is part of the Civil Service and the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Property Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Property function
bodies.description: The Government Property Profession is a network of over 2,000 members with responsibility for a range of property-related activities. The Government Property Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Cyber Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Digital function
bodies.description: The Government Cyber Profession provides shared standards, guidance and support to build capability and strengthen cyber security within government. The Government Cyber Profession is part of the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology .

bodies.name: Government Data Quality Hub
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Digital function
bodies.description: We work across government and beyond to make data better. DQHub is part of the Office for National Statistics .

bodies.name: Government Digital Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Digital function
bodies.description: We are the digital centre of government. We serve the public, central government departments and the wider public sector. GDS is part of the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport .

bodies.name: Government Office for Technology Transfer
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Digital function
bodies.description: GOTT helps accelerate government’s innovations towards the market, to impact growth and deliver new products and services for citizens. GOTT is part of the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade .

bodies.name: Government Actuary's Department
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Finance function
bodies.description: We provide actuarial solutions, including financial risk analysis, modelling and advice, to support the UK public sector. GAD is a non-ministerial department.

bodies.name: Government Corporate Finance Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Finance function
bodies.description: The Government Corporate Finance Profession (GCFP) brings together those working in corporate finance from across government to share learning and experience. GCFP is part of the UK Government Investments .

bodies.name: Government Finance Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Finance function
bodies.description: The Government Finance Function enables the delivery of high quality public services and ensures that public money is spent efficiently and effectively. GFF is part of the Civil Service and HM Treasury .

bodies.name: Government Security Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Security function
bodies.description: The Government Security Profession brings security professionals working in government together to help them gain skills and knowledge. The Government Security Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: UK National Authority for Counter-Eavesdropping
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Security function
bodies.description: The UK National Authority for Counter Eavesdropping (UK NACE) protects national security by providing Technical Security expertise to the government and the critical national infrastructure (CNI). We provide leadership for the technical security profession across government. UK NACE is part of the FCDO Services .

bodies.name: Government Commercial Agency
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Commercial function
bodies.description: We are the UK’s largest public procurement agency, helping the public sector maximise value for the nation when buying common goods and services. GCA is an executive agency, sponsored by the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Commercial Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Commercial function
bodies.description: The Government Commercial Function is a cross-government network procuring or supporting the procurement of goods and services for the government. GCF is part of the Civil Service and the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Internal Audit Agency
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Internal audit function
bodies.description: Our people provide objective insight so that central government can achieve better outcomes and value for money for the public. GIAA is an executive agency, sponsored by HM Treasury .

bodies.name: Internal Audit Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Internal audit function
bodies.description: The internal audit profession involves providing independent assurance and advisory services to organizations, evaluating and improving the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control processes. The Internal Audit Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Analysis Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: The Government Analysis Function is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Economic Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: Supporting economists in the Civil Service. GES is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Geography Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: The Government Geography Profession was established in 2018 to support geographical expertise across the public sector. The Government Geography Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Operational Research Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: Using scientific and mathematical techniques to find better solutions to complex management problems and improve decision making in government. GORS is part of the Civil Service and the Cabinet Office .

bodies.name: Government Social Research Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: The Government Social Research profession supports the development, implementation, review and evaluation of government policy. The Government Social Research Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Statistical Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Analysis function
bodies.description: The Government Statistical Service is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Communication Service
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Communication function
bodies.description: We support all professional communicators across government to gain the skills and knowledge they need to carry out their roles. GCS is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Public Sector Fraud Authority
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Counter fraud function
bodies.description: The Public Sector Fraud Authority works with departments and public bodies to understand and reduce the impact of fraud. PSFA is part of the Cabinet Office and HM Treasury .

bodies.name: Government Debt Management Function
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Debt function
bodies.description: GDMF works with HM Treasury and the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Government Legal Department
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Legal function
bodies.description: We are the government’s principal legal advisers. Our core purpose is to help the government to govern well, within the rule of law. GLD is a non-ministerial department.

bodies.name: Government Legal Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Legal function
bodies.description: Government lawyers provide legal advice to the government and represent it in court proceedings GLP is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: Policy Profession
bodies.basis: name is government-internal and names the Policy function
bodies.description: The Policy Profession helps to build capability and develop the right skills for policy professionals across the Civil Service. The Policy Profession is part of the Civil Service .

bodies.name: NHS Business Services Authority
bodies.basis: public-facing body whose own GOV.UK description says it provides central services to government or the public sector, without naming the function
bodies.description: NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA) is an arm’s length body of the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC). It provides critical central services to support the priorities of the NHS, government, and local health economies. NHSBSA is a special health authority, sponsored by the Department of Health and Social Care .
